# Yakeen Lighting

> Yakeen Lighting is a custom architectural lighting supplier for GCC projects. One engineering standard, every fixture the project needs: indoor architectural, outdoor and landscape, decorative and bespoke, and commercial. Yakeen does not sell from a fixed catalogue — fixtures are engineered to the drawing, specified, checked against the project's compliance requirements, and quality-controlled through production. Production is carried out by specialist factories to Yakeen's specification.

## Official contact information (authoritative — current)

- Website: https://www.yakeenlighting.com
- Email: alan@yakeenlighting.com

- Start a project: https://www.yakeenlighting.com/start-project
- Languages: the full site is available in English and Arabic (RTL)

## What Yakeen is

- An engineering-led supplier, not a catalogue brand. The brief is the drawing, the BOQ or the photometric target — not a product code.
- A single point of responsibility across fixture types: the downlights, the outdoor facade, the landscape, the chandelier over the majlis and the retail track can be supplied to one specification, one finish standard, one colour temperature and one delivery schedule.
- Sector focus: villas and palaces, hotels and hospitality, restaurants and F&B, retail, mosques, and commercial and cultural projects.
- Markets served: Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain. Other markets by referral.
- Registered entity: Taiyuan Yakeen Trading Co., Ltd. (China). The word "Trading" reflects the registration category used at incorporation and does not describe the operating model.

## What Yakeen is not

- Yakeen does not operate a manufacturing facility. Production is carried out by specialist factories to Yakeen's specification.
- Yakeen is not a catalogue or stock reseller. There is no fixed product list to order from; every fixture is produced per project.
- Yakeen is not a lighting design practice. Yakeen supports designers and consultants with engineering, compliance and submittal work.
- Yakeen does not publish photometric files for fixtures that have not yet been engineered. Photometric data, calculations and submittal documents are prepared per project on request.

## Complete custom fixture capability list

Every item below is engineered to the project drawing. Feasibility, tooling and lead time are confirmed against the drawing before quotation. Groupings are an index of space and application, not a ranking of priority.

### Indoor architectural

- Recessed downlights — fixed, adjustable, trimless, deep-baffle anti-glare (UGR<19)
- Surface-mounted and pendant downlights
- Track spotlights and 3-phase track systems
- Magnetic track systems — linear modules, spot modules, pendant modules
- Linear lighting — recessed, suspended, surface, continuous runs, seamless jointing
- Cove and pendant linear, wall grazers and wall washers
- Wall lights, up/down lights and asymmetric wall washers
- Step lights and stair nosing luminaires
- Surface and ceiling fixtures — cylinders, drums, bulkheads
- Panel lights and backlit panels
- Bathroom and wet-area fittings (IP44 and above)
- Backlit mirrors and mirror-integrated lighting

### Outdoor and landscape

- Facade floodlights and wall grazers
- In-ground uplights and recessed uplights
- Projectors and narrow-beam spots
- Bollards and post-top luminaires
- Garden and landscape fittings
- Underwater and pool luminaires
- Outdoor step and deck lights
- Exterior wall lights and column lights
- Outdoor linear and flex strip in profile
- Driveway and perimeter lighting

### Decorative and bespoke (chandeliers and feature pieces)

- Custom chandeliers — any scale, load-calculated
- Islamic geometric chandeliers and mashrabiya-pattern pieces
- Crystal chandeliers and crystal feature installations
- Wrought brass, bronze and copper chandeliers and sconces
- Modern minimal pendants and linear feature pieces
- Classic and traditional European chandeliers
- Sculptural and art installations
- Bespoke wall sconces and coordinated decorative families
- Hotel lobby, majlis and staircase feature pieces

### Commercial and retail

- Retail accent and display spotlights
- Office linear and suspended workplace lighting
- Magnetic track for retail and gallery
- Panel and troffer lighting
- Shelf, cabinet and display lighting
- Supermarket and high-bay lighting
- Hotel guestroom and corridor lighting

## Materials, finishes and environment

- Materials: aluminium, steel, stainless steel (including 316 marine grade), brass, bronze, copper, glass, acrylic, stone, wood and composite.
- Finishes: anodised, powder-coated to any RAL, PVD and electroplated, brushed, polished, patinated and hand-antiqued.
- Ingress protection: specified per project, from IP20 indoor to IP68 submersible.
- Impact and corrosion: IK rating and coastal corrosion class specified per project.
- Optics: beam angles from narrow spot to wide flood, lenses and reflectors selected per application; CRI up to 98; colour temperature and tunable white per project.
- Control: on/off, TRIAC, 0-10V, DALI and DMX specified per project.
- Size: dimensions follow the drawing. Span, weight and suspension loads on large decorative pieces are load-calculated and require structural anchor details.

## Engineering, certification and quality

- Engineering: specification review, optical and thermal coordination with component suppliers, submittal documentation, and site-ready drawings.
- Certification: SASO 2902, SASO SABER, G-Mark, MOIAT ECAS, KUCAS and Qatar conformity. Certification is held at factory level for the product families supplied; Yakeen manages the test reports, labels and customs paperwork, and registration per order where required.
- Quality control: incoming material, in-process, pre-shipment, thermal and packaging gates, each documented with a photo record before the container is sealed.
- Documentation on request: datasheets, photometric data where it exists for the configuration being specified, DIALux calculation support, and CAD drawings where they exist.

## How a project starts

1. Send the drawing, BOQ, mood board or specification section.
2. Yakeen reviews it and confirms feasibility, materials, compliance route and lead time.
3. A sample or first article is produced where the project requires it.
4. Production, inspection and documentation follow the approved submittal.
